title: Checkbox: Indeterminate (daisyUI)
notes:
Checkboxes are used to select or deselect a value.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/checkbox/+page.md
code:
<!-- You can make a checkbox indeterminate using JS -->
<script>
  document.getElementById("my-checkbox").indeterminate = true
</script>
<input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" id="my-checkbox" />
